products.short_description:
DTF Gang Sheets

DTF (Direct-to-Film) gang sheets allow you to print multiple designs on one sheet, giving you maximum flexibility and cost savings. Perfect for small businesses, brands, teams, events, and creators who want professional-quality transfers without minimums per design. The sheet will print exactly as loaded. All backgrounds need to be transparent before loading.

Our DTF gang sheets are printed using high-quality inks and premium film for vibrant colors, smooth gradients, and excellent stretch and durability. Transfers are ready to press on a wide range of materials including cotton, polyester, blends, and more.

Why Choose Our DTF Gang Sheets?

-

-

-
Print multiple designs on one sheet

-
No minimum per design

-
Full-color printing with white ink

-
Soft feel with long-lasting durability

-
Works on light or dark garments

-
Hot or cold peel options available
